arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
# Unemployment Trust Fund total balance values (in millions)
balances = {
    1936: 18.9,
    1937: 312.4,
    1938: 884.2,
    1939: 1280.5,
    1940: 1724.9,
    1941: 2283.7,
    1942: 3150.1
}

# Calculate 4-year moving averages (forward-looking: avg of year i, i+1, i+2, i+3)
# This gives us moving averages centered on the second year of the window
moving_averages = {}
for year in range(1936, 1939 + 1):  # 1936, 1937, 1938, 1939
    ma = (balances[year] + balances[year+1] + balances[year+2] + balances[year+3]) / 4
    moving_averages[year] = ma
    print(f"4-year MA for {year}: ({balances[year]} + {balances[year+1]} + {balances[year+2]} + {balances[year+3]}) / 4 = {ma}")

print("\n--- Moving averages rounded to tenths ---")
for year, ma in moving_averages.items():
    print(f"{year}: {round(ma, 1)}")

# Find the range
mas = list(moving_averages.values())
min_ma = min(mas)
max_ma = max(mas)

print(f"\nRange of 4-year moving averages: {round(min_ma, 1)} to {round(max_ma, 1)}")
print(f"Min: {round(min_ma, 1)}, Max: {round(max_ma, 1)}")
EOF

arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
# Unemployment Trust Fund total balance values (in millions)
balances = {
    1936: 18.9,
    1937: 312.4,
    1938: 884.2,
    1939: 1280.5,
    1940: 1724.9,
    1941: 2283.7,
    1942: 3150.1
}

# Option 1: Forward-looking 4-year MA (year and next 3 years)
print("=== Forward-looking 4-year MA (year + next 3 years) ===")
forward_mas = {}
for year in range(1936, 1939 + 1):  # 1936-1939
    ma = (balances[year] + balances[year+1] + balances[year+2] + balances[year+3]) / 4
    forward_mas[year] = ma
    print(f"MA starting {year}: {round(ma, 1)}")

print(f"\nRange: {round(min(forward_mas.values()), 1)} to {round(max(forward_mas.values()), 1)}")

print("\n=== Backwards-looking 4-year MA (year and previous 3 years) ===")
backward_mas = {}
for year in range(1939, 1942 + 1):  # 1939-1942 (need 4 years of data)
    ma = (balances[year-3] + balances[year-2] + balances[year-1] + balances[year]) / 4
    backward_mas[year] = ma
    print(f"MA for {year}: {round(ma, 1)}")

print(f"\nRange: {round(min(backward_mas.values()), 1)} to {round(max(backward_mas.values()), 1)}")

# Actually with 7 years of data, we could also do centered
print("\n=== All possible 4-year windows ===")
for start_year in range(1936, 1939 + 1):
    years = [start_year, start_year+1, start_year+2, start_year+3]
    values = [balances[y] for y in years]
    ma = sum(values) / 4
    print(f"Window {years}: avg = {round(ma, 1)}")
EOF
